title: Literary narration and dialogue revision — first story-wide pass
description: Selected source-checked literary revisions across the opening and Chapters 2–9, focusing on narration, natural Persian syntax, dialogue register, tense consistency, and preserving emotional restraint. Draft layer; independent native-Persian literary sign-off remains pending.
style_guide: Narration uses contemporary literary-conversational Persian: intimate, restrained, natural, and never uniformly formal or slang-heavy.
Dialogue remains spoken and character-specific; avoid making every character sound like the narrator.
Preserve fragments, repetition, pauses, imagery, emotional distance, and deliberate understatement.
Correct translationese, tense drift, awkward collocations, omissions, and source misalignment without embellishing the source.
Keep proper names and terminology consistent; compare every substantive change against the English source.

review_scope.method: Targeted source-checked literary revisions across the opening and Chapters 2–9. The additional pass revisits narrative voice, dialogue register, syntax, tense, and source fidelity. The Narcissus/Echo sequence and closing chapter are checked for terminology and tonal consistency. This is selective coverage of the existing Increment 52 alignment layer, not a complete line-by-line review of all story events.
